title: Auth Is Authoring
blurb: Three artifacts: source map → Auth cards → GraphData. Auth never means login.

chapters.title: Not login
chapters.text: Stop. Auth in Grove means authoring. Grove Auth Graph and Auth cards are Scriptable Objects from import. They are not authentication, not JWT, not login.
chapters.deep: Package types: GroveAuth, GroveAuthGraph, GroveExecutionAuth, GroveDataAuth under BovineLabs.Grove.Authoring. Runtime assembly has no Auth types for execution.

chapters.title: Three artifacts
chapters.text: Source map is the pretty Graph Toolkit file. Import builds the Auth graph and Auth cards. Bake freezes Graph Data. Play only opens the brick.
chapters.deep: Pipeline: GroveGraph asset → GroveImporter → GroveAuthGraph + subassets → GraphAuthoring reference → GraphBakingSystem → BlobAssetReference GraphData on IGraphReference.

chapters.title: Who points where
chapters.text: Graph Authoring on a Game Object points at the Auth graph. Bake calls Create on Auth cards. The entity gets an I Graph Reference holding the blob.
chapters.deep: GraphAuthoring of TAuth Graph comma TComponent. GraphBaker.Bake registers dependencies. Never assign the .mygraph to authoring.

chapters.title: Not login
chapters.text: If you hear Auth and think security login, rewire your brain. Here Auth only means authoring intermediate cards.
chapters.deep: There is no OAuth in com.bovinelabs.grove. Auth is a historical short name for authoring serialization objects.

source.label: Source map
source.short: Source map. Graph Toolkit draw asset. Editor only.
source.deep: Derives GroveGraph. Never read at runtime or bake after import.

importer.label: Importer
importer.short: Importer. Builds Auth graph and Auth cards from the pretty map.
importer.deep: GroveImporter ScriptedImporter. Sets Root when exactly one Input to execution.

auth_graph.label: Auth graph
auth_graph.short: Auth graph. GroveAuthGraph main asset. Authoring — not login.
auth_graph.deep: Fields Root, Inputs, Outputs, Nodes. Create builds GraphData blob.

auth_card.label: Auth card
auth_card.short: Auth card. One Grove star Auth Scriptable Object per node.
auth_card.deep: Create and Init write header plus payload and BlobPtr kids via AuthUtil.

authoring.label: GraphAuthoring
authoring.short: Graph Authoring. MonoBehaviour pointing at an Auth graph.
authoring.deep: Plus variants and instance overrides. Implements IGraphBaking.

bake.label: Bake
bake.short: Bake. Auth Create freezes the brick.
bake.deep: Applies overrides then Create. Variants strip unselected branches.

brick.label: GraphData
brick.short: Graph Data brick. Runtime only opens this blob.

entity.label: Entity
entity.short: Entity with I Graph Reference holding the blob ref.

not_login.label: NOT login
not_login.short: NOT login. Zero JWT. Auth means authoring.
not_login.deep: Say authoring cards when teaching humans.

play.label: Play
play.short: Play. Graph Execution walks Root every tick.
play.deep: GraphImpl owns the robot; system calls Execute.
